public_source_audit.source: Godin & Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719, published 2026-08-25
observations: The live PLOS article still links S1 Code as DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 (Code.zip), but file-level recovery remained blocked in the available public transport during this invocation.
The paper states that SPLiT tracks the empirical low-dimensional activity subspace with online Oja learning and trains a normalized-LMS decoder in manifold coordinates.

The paper explicitly describes the constrained condition as an idealized explicit low-dimensional projection and states that full-space FORCE/RLS becomes ill-conditioned when recurrent activity covariance is low-rank.

The paper's within-manifold perturbation is an orthogonal coordinate remapping that preserves the underlying manifold, whereas outside-manifold perturbation rotates the decoder basis toward directions orthogonal to the manifold.
public_source_audit.scope: Paper inspection only; no source-exact S1 Code execution or S8/S11/S12 reproduction was possible.

bounded_audit.status: strong full-space RLS plus generic-subspace-tracker control; non-reproduction
bounded_audit.purpose: Test whether adaptive intrinsic-coordinate learning retains an advantage over a tuned true full-space recursive least-squares readout, and whether any advantage depends on ambient-to-intrinsic dimension ratio and available sample budget rather than on Oja specifically.

latent_and_observation_model.target: fixed linear readout of latent coordinates
latent_and_observation_model.ambient_drift: true ambient subspace rotation by 80 degrees from an initial orthogonal k-subspace toward an orthogonal complement; warmup 15% of samples, drift over the next 45%, then stationary final subspace
latent_and_observation_model.observation_noise: isotropic Gaussian sigma=0.1/sqrt(N), approximately holding total ambient noise norm fixed

oja_intrinsic.decoder: normalized LMS in tracked k coordinates

generic_past_intrinsic.decoder: same normalized LMS in tracked k coordinates
generic_past_intrinsic.beta_selection: selected on four separate N=100 tuning seeds per budget

full_space_rls.decoder: full N-dimensional recursive least squares with forgetting and ridge-initialized inverse covariance
full_space_rls.lambda_selection: selected separately for each N,T cell on two separate tuning seeds; N=200,T=3200 used the relevant high-lambda subset

oracle_intrinsic.decoder: same normalized LMS as intrinsic trackers

design.evaluation: eight held-out paired seeds per N,T cell. The high-budget crossover at N=20 and adjacent N=50 cell were independently expanded to 24 paired evaluation seeds.

results.generic_tracker_vs_oja: PAST matched Oja to numerical/very small differences in most cells and was much closer to the oracle than Oja in the hardest short-budget N=200 cell (PAST 5.84e-5 vs Oja 8.32e-5). This is evidence against an Oja-specific interpretation of the synthetic advantage.
results.crossover_summary: At the shortest budget T=800, intrinsic tracking beat tuned full-space RLS at every tested N. At T=1600, N=20 was statistically indistinguishable while N>=50 retained a clear intrinsic advantage. At T=3200, expanded evaluation showed full-space RLS clearly better at N=20 (N/k=6.7) but intrinsic tracking still clearly better at N=50 (N/k=16.7) and in the 8-seed N=100/200 cells. Thus the advantage is not unconditional or asymptotic; it grows with ambient nuisance dimensionality and limited sample budget.

bounded_audit.interpretation: This bounded control strengthens the transferable mechanism as adaptive low-dimensional subspace tracking plus intrinsic-coordinate learning for high N/k or limited-data drifting representations. A tuned true full-space RLS control can erase or reverse the advantage when ambient dimension is small and sample budget is large, so the effect is best understood as a conditioning/sample-efficiency regime rather than universal superiority over full-space least squares. Generic PAST-style tracking largely matches Oja, so no Oja-specific computational advantage is established.
limits: Synthetic linear-latent observation model; not the authors' recurrent network and not a reproduction of S8/S11/S12.
Full-space RLS uses a stronger optimizer than the paper-like intrinsic normalized LMS; this is intentional as a stress test but means solver class and subspace restriction are not fully factorized.
RLS forgetting factors were tuned on only two separate seeds per N,T cell and are not exhaustive hyperparameter optima.
PAST beta was tuned on separate N=100 seeds per budget rather than separately for every N.
Methods are not compute- or memory-matched: full RLS stores an N-by-N inverse covariance while intrinsic trackers maintain O(Nk) state.
Do not generalize numeric crossover thresholds outside this bounded ambient-drift/noise model.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Under genuine ambient subspace drift, adaptive low-dimensional tracking with intrinsic-coordinate learning can outperform even a tuned full-space RLS readout when N/k is large or the sample budget is limited.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: At small N/k with enough samples, tuned full-space RLS can catch up or outperform the paper-like intrinsic NLMS pipeline; the advantage is not universal or asymptotic.
candidate_update.specificity: Generic PAST-style tracking matches or exceeds Oja in this bounded model, so the computational value is subspace tracking rather than Oja specifically.
